# FLOP Control Center

Public-safe local operator dashboard for FLOP-oriented development stacks.

## Start
- Demo: `python server_public.py --demo`
- Real use: copy `config/config.example.json` to `config/config.local.json`, configure explicit allowlists, run `python server_public.py`.

## Read
- `GET /api/status`: repository health, network/GitHub summaries, bounded logs, task state, jobs, alerts.

## Reversible actions
- `POST /api/check`
- `POST /api/open`
- `POST /api/task` (`start` or `stop`)

## Safety
No signer custody, key export, settlement, protocol publication, autonomous response policy, roster consent, or irreversible protocol actions. Demo mode is read-only.

See `AGENTS.md`, `SKILL.md`, `docs/MODULE_CONTRACT.md`, and `docs/PUBLICATION_BOUNDARY.md`.
